description: 울산광역시 울주군_방사능 방재정보 출입통제소 조회 서비스 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 울산광역시 울주군. 이 데이터는 주로 울주군 내 주요 국도, 지방도, 고속도로 IC 등 통제가 필요한 전략적 지점들을 포함하고 있어, 다른 방재 데이터(대피소, 병원 등)와 결합했을 때 효과적인 대피. Coverage: 울산광역시 울주군. The portal files it under the publisher 울산광역시 울주군. Its tags are 방사능, 방재정보, 출입통제소, 지도, 위치. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
